action.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-05' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-04' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN g.period = '2026-04' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS pct_change FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period IN ('2026-04', '2026-05')
